The '''GP-2 medical droid''' was a class of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] that was used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. At least one such [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was stationed aboard the Alliance [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]<ref name="Invincible" /> in [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' tp [[41 ABY]].</ref>
